title: Crack Widening Acceleration Watch
dataSources: Mould risk (`mould:risk`), crack meters (`crackmeter:reading`), HVAC filter life (`hvacfilter:life`), structural tilt (`structural:tilt`).
app: Building-health sensors — indoor humidity / mould-risk monitors, crack and tilt meters, HVAC filter-life trackers, and damp sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and ESPHome.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=crackmeter:reading
| sort 0 sensor _time
| streamstats current=f last(width_mm) as prev_width by sensor
| eval growth_mm=round(width_mm-prev_width,2)
| stats max(growth_mm) as max_growth, latest(width_mm) as latest_width by sensor
| where max_growth>0.5
| sort - max_growth
description: Flags structural cracks whose widening rate has accelerated beyond recent behaviour.
value: Acceleration matters more than the absolute number because it hints that movement may be active rather than historical.
implementation: Send crack-width readings to `index=personal`; compare each reading with the previous one and alert on sharp growth.
visualization: Sensor table of latest width and maximum recent growth.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which structural cracks are starting to widen faster than before, which matters more than a single static reading.
